**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Add a HF example for the new architecture**

Registering `Gemma4ForSequenceClassification` here makes it part of `ModelRegistry.get_supported_archs()`, but there is no matching entry in `tests/models/registry.py` (`rg "Gemma4ForSequenceClassification" tests/models/registry.py` returns none). The repository coverage test `tests/models/test_registry.py::test_hf_registry_coverage` subtracts `HF_EXAMPLE_MODELS.get_supported_archs()` from the model registry and fails for any unlisted architecture, so this change will break CI until an example model entry is added or the architecture is otherwise excluded.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
I think you don’t need to do anything, vLLM will do the conversion automatically.
